name: pi-code
description: VS Code UI for the Pi coding agent

pi-code.apiProvider.description: Provider whose API key the Settings page is currently managing. The actual provider used at runtime is determined by the selected model; this setting only chooses which provider's stored key the Settings form shows for editing.

pi-code.defaultModel.description: Default model ID to use when starting new sessions (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-20250514). Leave empty for automatic selection.

pi-code.thinkingLevel.description: Default thinking level for Pi Code responses

pi-code.allowedTools.description: Restrict which tools the agent can use. Leave empty to allow all tools.

pi-code.fileMentions.enabled.description: Enable @ file mentions in chat input for files in the opened workspace.

pi-code.fileMentions.useDefaultExcludes.description: Use Pi Code's built-in exclude patterns when indexing workspace files for @ mentions.

pi-code.fileMentions.exclude.description: Additional glob patterns to exclude from @ file mention suggestions.

pi-code.fileMentions.maxSuggestions.description: Maximum number of @ file mention suggestions to show.

pi-code.fileMentions.configPath.description: Workspace-relative JSON config file for @ file mention indexing settings.

pi-code.planMode.defaultEnabled.description: Enable Plan Mode for new chats by default. When on, the agent studies the task and proposes a plan before making any changes. Each chat keeps its own toggle state.

pi-code.fileUndoView.defaultEnabled.description: Show the File Undo View — the bar above the prompt input listing files the agent changed, with Undo / Redo / Review buttons — by default for new chats. File edits still happen and can be inspected per-message regardless; this only controls the always-visible bar. Each chat keeps its own toggle state.

pi-code.todo.defaultEnabled.description: Enable the per-chat persistent ToDo for new chats by default. Each chat keeps its own toggle state once you flip it; this setting only affects chats you have not customized yet.

pi-code.lsp.enabled.description: Expose Language Server tools (find_references, document_symbols, goto_definition, hover, find_implementations, type_definition, workspace_symbols, call_hierarchy_incoming, call_hierarchy_outgoing) to the agent. When disabled (default), the tools are not registered and add nothing to the system prompt — the agent works with grep / read / etc. as usual. Enable for projects where semantic accuracy is worth the extra system-prompt footprint (e.g. large Unity / Rust / TS codebases with name collisions). Tools require a language extension to be installed for each file's language (e.g. C# Dev Kit, rust-analyzer, Pylance). Changes apply on new sessions or window reload.

pi-code.todo.promptGuidelines.default:
ALWAYS create a `todo` for every actionable request before starting work — even single-step tasks. Skip only for purely conversational replies that produce no code, files, or commands.
Mark in_progress BEFORE doing the work, completed IMMEDIATELY when done. Exactly one task in_progress at a time; never batch completions.
Don't mark completed when tests fail, work is partial, or errors are unresolved — keep it in_progress and add a new task for the blocker.
Use `blockedBy` for dependencies (cycles are rejected).
Subject must be short and imperative (e.g. "Research existing tool"); put long detail in `description`; pass `activeForm` (present-continuous, e.g. "researching existing tool") when marking in_progress.
pi-code.todo.promptGuidelines.description: Prompt guidelines injected into the system prompt for the ToDo tool. One guideline per line. Changes apply to new chat sessions — open a new chat or reload the window for them to take effect. Clearing the field restores the built-in default.

pi-code.userMessageGlowColor.description: Color of the subtle glow outline around user messages in the chat. Any valid CSS color.

pi-code.userMessageGlowOpacity.description: Opacity of the glow around user messages, as a percentage (0 = invisible, 100 = fully opaque).

scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run compile:integration-tests && node out/test/integration/runTest.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.deploy: npm run compile && npm prune --omit=dev && npm run package && npm install && node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); require('child_process').execSync('code --install-extension '+p.name+'-'+p.version+'.vsix --force', {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.deploy:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:minor: npm run version:minor && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:major: npm run version:major && npm run deploy
